name: The Estate Pantry
address: Kanjar–Pullikanam–Vagamon Road, Pullikanam Tea Estate, Vagamon, Kerala

story.title: Seventy years old. Gently restored.
body: The Estate Pantry lives inside the old Field Officers' Quarters of the Pullikanam Tea Estate, a colonial-era building that has watched over these hills for seventy years.
We didn't rebuild it. We restored it slowly and carefully, so the walls still carry their history and the rooms still feel like they did when the estate was young.
Come in, sit down, and take your time. Nobody's in a hurry here.

food.title: Honest food. Nothing trendy.
body: Our kitchen is built around a traditional brick oven. Every pizza starts as a slow-fermented dough, is stretched by hand, and is baked in wood fire.
We cook with what the estate and the region give us, and we keep it simple: good ingredients, patient hands, proper heat.

pillars.title: Slow-fermented
pillars.text: Dough rested long enough to be light, airy and full of flavour.

pillars.title: Wood-fired
pillars.text: A real brick oven, real flame, a blistered crust.

pillars.title: Estate-grown
pillars.text: Local and estate ingredients wherever we can, because it tastes better and it's the right way to cook.

menu.name: Spiced Chicken Pizza
menu.description: Hand-stretched dough, spiced chicken, blistered in the brick oven.

menu.name: Rosemary Herb Garlic Bread
menu.description: Pulled from the oven with rosemary, garlic, and a little smoke.

menu.name: Pasta
menu.description: A bowl of whatever we made this afternoon. Soft, simple, to share.

menu.name: Spaghetti
menu.description: Long noodles, a quiet sauce, eaten slowly.

menu.name: Freshly Baked Treats
menu.description: Whatever came out of the oven this morning. Ask at the counter.

menu.name: Estate Tea
menu.description: Leaf from the gardens around the quarters, poured when you are ready.

menu.name: Mango Juice
menu.description: Cold mango. Nothing else in the glass.

menu.name: Peach Iced Tea
menu.description: Estate tea, chilled, a little peach.

menu.name: Lemon Iced Tea
menu.description: Estate tea, lemon, ice. Sharp enough for the afternoon.

menuNote: Menu changes with the season and the oven. Ask us what's fresh today.

estate.title: Mist, tea, and unhurried afternoons.
body: We sit in the middle of the Pullikanam Tea Estate. Look out and you'll see rows of tea running down into the mist.
Bring a book, bring a friend, bring the dog. We're pet-friendly, we're quiet, and the only thing on the schedule is the view.

visit.title: Find us in the hills.
visit.body: Right on the Kanjar–Pullikanam–Vagamon Road, inside the Pullikanam Tea Estate. Part of The Highland Circle, along with the Vanilla County heritage homestay next door.
